implementation: macos_lifecycle.rs creates a custom NSApplication before winit; terminate: queues a request consumed by about_to_wait, calling the existing fallible quit/save path. Winit owns its delegate and window.
limits: Cmd-Q and window close were exercised. Dock Quit uses the same terminate: override but was not separately clicked.
Force Quit, crashes, power loss and OS logout remain outside these UI checks.
Utility state was seeded synthetically; stopwatch resume/stop and timer acknowledgment used actual keyboard input.
Some repeated CUA screenshots omit unchanged regions; screenshots are observation evidence, not pixel-difference baselines.
No new live-network or handset compatibility claim.
